historical_basis.quote: Manannán or Manann , also known as Manannán mac Lir ('son of the Sea'), is a sea god, warrior and king of the otherworld in Gaelic (Irish, Manx and Scottish) mythology who is one of the Tuatha Dé Danann .

statement.id: Manannán (Manann, Manannán mac Lir, son of the Sea) adalah dewa laut, pejuang, dan raja dunia lain mitologi Gaelik (Gaelic: Irish, Manx, Scottish), salah satu Tuatha Dé Danann.
statement.en: Manannán (Manann, Manannán mac Lir, son of the Sea) is a sea god, warrior and otherworld king of Gaelic (Irish, Manx, Scottish) myth, one of the Tuatha Dé Danann.

historical_basis.quote: He is said to own a self-navigating boat named Sguaba Tuinne ('Wave-sweeper'), a horse Aonbharr which can course over water as well as land and a deadly strength-sapping sword named Fragarach

statement.id: Ia memiliki perahu Sguaba Tuinne (Wave-sweeper, Penyapu Ombak), kuda Aonbharr yang berlari di air dan darat, dan pedang Fragarach.
statement.en: He owns the boat Sguaba Tuinne (Wave-sweeper), the horse Aonbharr that runs over water and land, and the sword Fragarach.

presentation_revision_history.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: ONE square refined painterly folklore encyclopedia illustration for Mythics. Subject: MANANNAN MAC LIR in the directly recorded County Monaghan giant-EEL transformation from the National Folklore Collection, not human sea-god portrait. One wholly fish-anatomied giant freshwater eel at the bottom of a clear dark Irish lake, guarding one small closed old treasure chest on pebbled ground. Exactly ONE natural eel head, ONE long unbroken cylindrical eel body in a broad readable S-curve, ONE tapering tail, TWO small pectoral fins just behind head and a continuous low dorsal fin along back joining the tail fin. Smooth olive-grey wet eel skin, tiny scales; real eel mouth and eyes, no snake fangs or horn, no human face, arms or legs, wings, crown or clothes. Entire eel head/body/fins/tail uncropped with margin, no overlapping coils, transparent water so anatomy clear. Watchful ancient sorrowful treasure-guardian aura, dignified uncanny cursed divinity rather than snarling sea dragon. Painterly lake pebbles/reeds, deep forest-green submerged shadows, warm antique copper light catching chest and dorsal contour, moonlight from water surface. No bottle, extra animals, horses, human saint, blood, inscriptions, text, watermark or border. This is Manann's own source-attested eel manifestation and not his separate horse or an invented aquatic humanoid.
